_comment: SITE 9 AFTER A DEFERRED CONTINUATION: THE REPLAY DISPATCHES EACH SEGMENT'S ACTIVATIONS AT ITS END (alch-t3, 2026-11-20).
Regression d5_s3003 gi87 (seed 3090), turn 4: Stroke of Genius X=1 draws Staff of Domination (deferred site-3
continuation casts it); two MTG_SITE9_AFTER_DEFERRED continuations follow -- [Staff untaps the Alchemist (loop),
Ezuri pump] then [Staff loop, Ezuri pump, Ezuri pump]. The rollout applies each continuation's activations at
its end and scores the turn lethal (Alchemist untapped, Alchemist + Ezuri attack). The committed line's records
hold all of them in ONE list; replay_recorded pooled every activation into a single trailing pass, whose provider
sort ran both Staff loops ahead of all three pumps -- the Alchemist ended tapped, Ezuri attacked alone, the
opponent was left at 4 and the game ran on to turn 5 (committed T4 kill, realised T5). Same class: smoke d3 gi12,
regression d5_s3003 gi40 (a Stroke cast recorded AFTER a segment's activations was replayed BEFORE them).
